conventions.rgbMatrices: Native standard primaries and whites; derived matrices enabled in both directions.
conventions.rgbConversions: Linear RGB_to_RGB; explicit Bradford; CCTF decoding/encoding disabled; no clipping.
conventions.adaptation: Native chromatic_adaptation_VonKries; explicit transform; whites from native CIE 1931 2-degree CCS_ILLUMINANTS.
conventions.lab: Native XYZ_to_Lab with explicit native xy illuminant; stored whitepoint is native xy_to_XYZ (Y=1).
conventions.pipelineLab: Native derived sRGB RGB_to_XYZ with decoding, explicit Bradford or CAT02 adaptation D65 to D50, then native XYZ_to_Lab under D50.
conventions.xyY: Native XYZ_to_xyY returns [0,0,0] for black; our default D65 fallback is a documented convention difference. Native xyY_to_XYZ with y=0 also returns [0,0,0]; our inverse preserves the input Y.
conventions.ycbcr: Native RGB_to_YCbCr; explicit standard weights; full RGB input; float output; legal ranges at 8/10/12 bits; full-range Cb/Cr shifted by +0.5 to our unit convention.
conventions.rgbModels: Native RGB_to_HSL/HSV hue multiplied by 360; native RGB_to_CMY then CMY_to_CMYK; inputs in [0,1].
conventions.oklab: Unmodified native 0.4.4 Oklab matrices in both directions; intentionally differs from our CSS-corrected matrices. No fixture-side matrix substitution.
conventions.transfer: Native positive-domain CCTFs for every working space; BT.2020 uses native CONSTANTS_BT2020_PRECISE, not the rounded 10-bit default. Negative CSS sign extension is outside this parity dataset. Native sRGB decode splits at encode(0.0031308), slightly below our standard 0.04045. Native 0.4.4 BT.2020 inverse fails to forward PRECISE constants when computing its branch threshold; it calls default oetf_BT2020(beta). Those narrow decode intervals have explicit decodeDifference classifications. Probes straddle branch thresholds by 1e-10 to avoid NumPy/JS pow ulps choosing different discontinuous branches.
conventions.cmccat97: The CMCCAT97 compatibility identifier is the fully adapted linearized CIECAM97s/Bradford transform of ICC.1:2004-10 Annex E.3. It is not the complete nonlinear model and is excluded from native CMCCAT97 parity.
